node.title: KoalaBear coordinate Vieta profile-only F29 route cut
node.closure: an exact defect-two geometrically irreducible aligned source-facet packet over F_29 survives the positive Vieta rank gate but is deleted by its forced colored quotient quadratic
node.statement: Over F_29 there is a complete aligned abstract coordinate source-facet packet with the allowed paired K-degree profile (2,2),(4,4),(4,4), source degree four, four colored edges, defect two, and a geometrically irreducible positive bidegree-(2,4) source form whose 10 x 8 Vieta matrix has rank seven with full leading support. Its J-resultant forces c(W)=W^2-7W+9 with roots 13,23 outside the J support, and the companion I identity also fails. Thus profile/defect/irreducibility plus the determinant are not a sufficient universal exclusion interface; this is a route cut, not a deployed-field packet or orientation deletion.
